tools.name: get_prayer_times
tools.description: Get the five daily prayer times plus sunrise for a city or coordinates, computed with the same engine as the Wasilah app. On Fridays, Dhuhr is marked as Jumu’ah.

tools.name: get_next_prayer
tools.description: Get the next upcoming prayer and how long until it begins, for a city or coordinates.

tools.name: get_qibla
tools.description: Get the Qibla direction (compass bearing to the Kaaba) for a city or coordinates.

tools.name: get_hijri_date
tools.description: Get the Islamic (Hijri) date for a given Gregorian date, or today.

tools.name: get_ifb_district_offset
tools.description: Get the Islamic Foundation Bangladesh published time offset from Dhaka for a Bangladeshi district, for sehri end and iftar. Omit the district to list all 64. These are IFB's own published values, not a computation.

tools.name: get_hijri_calendar
tools.description: Get a full Hijri month mapped to Gregorian dates, with the significant days that fall in it. Give a Hijri year and month, or a Gregorian date to get the month containing it. Dates are calendar positions, not sighting announcements.

tools.name: get_asma_ul_husna
tools.description: Look up the 99 Names of Allah (Asma ul Husna). Returns Arabic, transliteration, English and Bengali. Give a number for one name, a search term to match by meaning or transliteration, or neither to get all 99.

tools.name: get_quran_audio
tools.description: Get streaming audio for a surah, plus the surah name and ayah count. Most reciters return a single full-surah URL; the rest return per-ayah numbering to build a playlist from.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_quran_audio" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get a streaming audio URL for full-surah Quran recitation, plus the surah name and ayah count." → after: "Get streaming audio for a surah, plus the surah name and ayah count. Most reciters return a single full-surah URL; the rest return per-ayah numbering to build a playlist from."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
